bio: Farington Lodge, a superb Grade II listed Georgian house set in three acres of mature lawns and gardens, blends lavish period splendour and a fascinating history with the very best contemporary luxury.  Brilliantly located close to the M6, M61 and M65 motorways, it sits in a quiet rural spot with rolling Lancashire countryside beyond making it ideal for Afternoon Tea not far from the best sightseeing in the North West, including the stunning Lake District National Park.
